0.0: I don't know if they told you during the orientation, but we're here to fight the Black Mage. Right now, you're not fit to fight a black mop. I'm gonna fix that.\r\nYou ready for some action?

yes.0: Your first stop is #eKimu#n. If you get lost, hit the #e#bQ key#k#n and check your #e#rQuest Info#k#n. That's tip number one: always check your quest info before you go running your mouth!
